## Summary
- Add new large "Docks" (Доки) map with industrial theme (5000x4000 px)
- Place 20 enemies with varied weapons and tactical positioning
- Include 3 open areas (at least 1 viewport size: 1280x720) between cover zones
- Create interesting gameplay situations with different enemy types and positions

## Map Layout
The Docks level features:
- **Crane Platform**: Elevated area with 2 guards (Rifle, UZI)
- **Container Yard A**: 3 enemies (2 Rifle, 1 Shotgun) with patrol routes
- **Container Yard B**: 3 enemies (Rifle, Shotgun, Machete)
- **Warehouse A**: Close-quarters area with 3 enemies (Shotgun, 2 UZI)
- **Warehouse B**: 3 enemies including a grenadier
- **Loading Dock**: 4 enemies (2 Rifle, UZI, Machete) with crate cover
- **Open Areas**: 3 large spaces (~1280x720 each) with 2 patrolling Rifle enemies

## Tactical Situations
1. Long-range engagements across open areas
2. CQB fights in warehouses
3. Container maze navigation
4. Flanking opportunities through multiple paths
5. Melee ambush possibilities

## Enemy Distribution (20 total)
| Weapon | Count | Locations |
|--------|-------|-----------|
| Rifle | 8 | Crane, Container Yards, Loading Dock, Open Areas |
| UZI | 5 | Crane, Warehouses, Loading Dock |
| Shotgun | 4 | Container Yards, Warehouse A |
| Machete | 2 | Loading Dock, Container Yard B |
| Grenadier | 1 | Warehouse B |

## Files Changed
- `scenes/levels/DocksLevel.tscn` - New level scene
- `scripts/levels/docks_level.gd` - Level script (based on beach_level.gd)
- `scripts/ui/levels_menu.gd` - Added Docks to level selection
- `docs/case-studies/issue-753/README.md` - Case study documentation

## Test Plan
- [ ] Level loads without errors
- [ ] All 20 enemies spawn correctly
- [ ] Player can navigate through all areas
- [ ] Navigation mesh works for enemies
- [ ] Level appears in level selection menu
- [ ] Victory triggers when all enemies eliminated
- [ ] CI workflows pass

Fixes Jhon-Crow/godot-topdown-MVP#753
